name: MP4 / MOV / 3GP (ISO media)
notes: Length from walking top-level boxes (ftyp, moov, mdat ...). Items with no moov box are flagged as incomplete. Length judged by mediacarve (header/parsed/capped); the mode is the fallback.

name: AVI (RIFF)
notes: RIFF chunk size + 8. OpenDML (AVIX) continuation chunks over 1 GB are separate RIFF chunks and are not joined in this build. Length judged by mediacarve (header/parsed/capped); the mode is the fallback.

name: Matroska / WebM (EBML)
notes: Length judged by mediacarve (header/parsed/capped); the mode is the fallback.

name: Hikvision export (IMKH + MPEG-PS)
notes: 40-byte IMKH header followed by an MPEG program stream. Takes max_size bytes; a Hikvision-aware length method comes in a later build. NOT VALIDATED - build test files from a known Hikvision unit.

name: Dahua DHAV frame chain
notes: Offsets follow publicly documented DHAV parsers (frame length at 12, packed date/time at 16, 'dhav' + 4-byte trailer). Channel offset 6 is UNCONFIRMED. NOT VALIDATED - confirm on a known Dahua drive and its exports before enabling for casework.
